{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Mainstream pop is less appealing right now than the blues and roots music I have been playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits: Decade #1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away makes this appealing, but I would pass on a hits collection this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A vocal duets album is not what I am looking for right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in bluesy guitar and roots songwriting than funk right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not draw me in as much as another blues or roots album would.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essentials; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this fits my interests, so I would skip it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its relaxed interpretations sound appealing alongside Memphis and Old Sock, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The familiar classic rock sound fits, but I am not motivated to pick up another compilation.
ItemID: NA; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its bluesy country sound seems a good fit for my recent listening; this is the one I would try.
ItemID: NA; Title: Same Trailer Different Park; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country songwriting interests me after Blown Away, but I would choose Traveller this time."}
